MINES: BASIC lines 240-460 read numeric entries. Sell an amount of ore no greater than the current stock, then a number of mines no greater than those owned. Next enter food spending no greater than the cash available, followed by a number of new mines affordable at the current price. Confirm each with Enter. The figures change each year.

We ran the original TZX in Fuse 48K at 100% speed. Wait 22 seconds for loading, press Enter, wait 0.5 seconds, press R then Enter, and wait 1.2 seconds. Type 10 and Enter for ore sales; wait 0.7 seconds. Type 1 and Enter for mines sold; wait 0.7 seconds. Type 2000 and Enter for food; wait 0.5 seconds. Type 0 and Enter for new mines, then wait 0.8 seconds. Each key is held for 0.08 seconds followed by a 0.16-second release. Random prices and people counts may differ on replay.
